acceptedAnswer.text: Emergency restoration companies, including First To Respond Restoration, understand the urgency of a fallen tree incident. Our teams are available 24/7 and aim to respond to calls within our service areas, including Encino, as quickly as possible, often within hours. Immediate response is critical to mitigate further damage from exposure to the elements and to secure your property. When you call, we prioritize dispatching a team to assess the situation and begin necessary emergency services like tarping or board-up.
